title: Book Two · Chapter 61: A Morning in Another Room
story:
Four weeks pass. On the agreed Saturday, Mum takes Ronan to Leo's reading room. They leave early. The cost paper stays in the tin at home. Ronan carries his pencil and a small bottle of water.

Leo waits near the door. He waves with his whole arm.

“You came!”

Mum talks to the adult at the desk. Then she shows Ronan the place for Dad to meet him. Ronan repeats the place. Mum squeezes his shoulder and leaves for her work.

Ronan finds his seat. It is beside a child he does not know. Leo sits at another table. Ronan looks at him across the room.

“Can I move?” he asks the teacher.

“First, try this pair. You can sit with Leo at the break.”

The child beside Ronan has a very sharp pencil. Ronan puts his own pencil beside it. He turns the points toward each other. They almost meet.

Their page is about a lost shoe. A child leaves one shoe at a field. Later, the child comes back with a parent. Ronan reads the opening lines without help. The other child reads the next part.

One word stops Ronan. He tries it twice. The child points to the picture of a muddy path. The teacher comes over and says the word slowly. Ronan reads the line again.

They must put three small pictures in order. Ronan reaches for the picture of the shoe first. His partner points to the child at home with one bare foot.

“First this one.”

Ronan checks the page. The story begins at home. He moves his hand away and takes the second picture.

By break, the order is right. Ronan goes to Leo's table with his water bottle.

“Did you get the muddy path?” Leo asks.

“Yes. Not at first.”

“I got a different page.”

Leo shows him a small drawing of a gate. Ronan is surprised. He thought everyone would read the same page. The room is ordinary. It is different from his picture of it.

After the break, Ronan answers one question alone. The teacher asks him to find the line about the shoe. He finds it and reads it clearly.

Dad waits at the agreed door after work. Ronan holds his own page. The teacher says he can take it home.

“Was it good?” Dad asks.

“Yes. I needed help with one word.”

They walk to the stop together. Ronan keeps the page flat against his bag. On the way home, he tells Dad about the sharp pencil first. Then he tells him about the right answer.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

seat＝座位；pair＝一对；teacher＝老师。

## 理解问题

1. Ronan为什么坐到不认识的孩子旁边？
2. 他的实际阅读表现怎样？

## 读句子

**Ronan / finds / his seat.** Ronan／找到／他的座位。
